items.title: Data Days: 100% exam voucher · take your exam by November 30, 2026
items.summary: Limited vouchers for DP-800, DP-700, DP-600. Eligibility applies; request one through Microsoft’s official offer page.
items.eligibility: One voucher per person; limited supply and eligibility requirements apply.
items.expiry_note: Exam completion deadline; your voucher may have an earlier redemption deadline. Confirm the dates on your offer.
items.attendance: Live and on-demand learning; check voucher eligibility separately.
article_paragraphs: This Data Days offer covers 100% of the fee for DP-800, DP-700, DP-600. Complete the exam by November 30, 2026. Availability is limited.
Request through Microsoft with your Fabric Community account. If allocated, the code arrives in your community private messages, not email. One voucher is permitted per person.
Check the linked terms and your voucher’s redemption deadline before scheduling. Extensions are not available. Attending a session alone does not guarantee a voucher.

items.title: Microsoft Ignite 2026: one free onsite certification exam
items.summary: Registered in-person attendees can take one Microsoft or GitHub certification exam at the San Francisco event. Limited seats; registration required.
items.eligibility: Registered Ignite in-person attendees only. One exam per person; regional restrictions apply.
items.expiry_note: Onsite offer window; not a voucher for remote testing.
article_paragraphs: The offer applies to one onsite Microsoft or GitHub exam during November 16, 2026–November 20, 2026. It does not provide a free remote exam or free conference admission.
Schedule through the certification page and select the Microsoft Ignite Event Test Center in San Francisco. The discount applies at checkout. Seats are limited.
Check the official page for eligible exams, regional exclusions and prerequisites. Government employees must confirm eligibility with their employer. The offer cannot be transferred or extended.
